data.exact_reserve_text: An overall deterioration of GBP 4.4 million on prior years' provisions was experienced during the year. Deteriorations of GBP 3.5 million on third-party liability, GBP 3.7 million on fire and other damage to property and GBP 1.5 million on reinsurance accepted were partially offset by improvements of GBP 1.1 million on marine, aviation and transport, GBP 2.0 million on pecuniary loss, GBP 0.6 million on motor and GBP 0.6 million on energy.
specific_events: Severe convective storm events (SCS) in USA 2023

prior_year_events.impact_description: Material exposure noted; increased uncertainty on reserves though not a material increase beyond normal uncertainty for an insurer at this stage of development.
Syndicate 2121 has material exposure to the Covid-19 pandemic; the report states this does not lead to a material increase in the uncertainty of the syndicate's total results in an adverse direction.

named_events.loss_description: Some very limited exposure to a number of assets in Israel; these exposures will be reduced over time, should hostilities continue.

named_events.event_name: Severe convective storm events (SCS) in USA
named_events.loss_description: Total insured loss from SCS events was estimated to be $60 billion (with eighteen individual events each greater than $1 billion).
Above average activity with twenty named storms; seven hurricanes and three major hurricanes, but majority avoided landfall and limited damage to date.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded an overall prior-year deterioration of GBP 4.4m (gross) in 2023 driven by adverse development primarily in thirdparty liability, fire & other damage to property and reinsurance accepted, partly offset by favourable development in marine/aviation/transport, pecuniary loss, motor and energy. The managing agent attributes portfolio impact to a mix of increased extreme weather activity (notably US severe convective storms and an active Atlantic hurricane season), geopolitical events (Russia-Ukraine conflict and Middle East hostilities) and ongoing claims development patterns across liability lines.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year movement: the only explicit quantified figure is a GBP 4.4m deterioration in prior years' provisions stated in the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' narrative. The note does not present a clear labelled GROSS movement table (Insurance liabilities column) in absolute form; therefore the reported GBP 4.4m has been used as the prior-year movement (treated as gross per the note wording). If a gross-only movement figure exists elsewhere in the file it was not clearly tabulated; fallback to net would have been flagged. The claims development table (gross) is present and has been captured but parsing of ragged rows required inserting nulls for cells with no reported value (newer underwriting years). Mappings: 'Pecuniary loss' mapped to 'Professional Lines' for LOB movements (approximate), 'Marine, aviation and transport' mapped to 'Marine'.
